newsitem.title: UK: Shaftesbury to buy properties, sets rights.
newsitem.headline: Shaftesbury to buy properties, sets rights.

text.p: Property investment firm Shaftesbury Plc said on Wednesday it had conditionally agreed to buy the Carnaby Estate comprising properties in London for 90 million stg.
The company also said it planned to raise about 36.5 million stg, net of expenses, by way of a three-for-eight rights issue of new ordinary shares at 137p per share.
The estate comprises 91 freehold buildings, one leasehold building and a site in and around Carnaby Street in the West End of London.
Shaftesbury's portfolio, including 122 shops and restaurants, is in the Chinatown, Covent Garden and Carnaby Street areas.
The company said its net assets per share rose to 132p for the year ended September 30 from 111p.
Shaftesbury's shares closed at about 159p on Tuesday.
